content.value_statement: Product teams often face unclear symptoms, competing priorities, and incomplete evidence. This skill identifies the core blocker and recommends a focused next action.
actual_capabilities: Diagnoses product, growth, operations, data, delivery, and collaboration problems.
Separates facts, assumptions, evidence gaps, constraints, and stakeholder interests.
Identifies the core blocker and the mechanism currently driving the result.
Recommends focused actions with timing, owners, metrics, and decision rules.
Applies detailed playbooks across 36 common product and business scenarios.
Produces concise Chinese guidance with stop-doing advice and limited follow-up questions.
limitations: Default responses use Chinese and focus on mainland China internet product contexts.
Recommendation quality depends on the accuracy and completeness of the supplied context.
The skill cannot access live dashboards, company systems, or private operational data.
High-stakes legal, financial, security, and compliance decisions require qualified review.

use_cases.title: Resolve roadmap conflicts
use_cases.description: Choose between planned work and new stakeholder requests using goals, evidence, constraints, and explicit tradeoffs.

use_cases.title: Diagnose stalled growth
use_cases.description: Identify whether acquisition, activation, retention, conversion, supply, or measurement is the main constraint.

use_cases.title: Unblock delivery and collaboration
use_cases.description: Clarify ownership, dependencies, decision rights, scope, and escalation triggers for delayed or disputed work.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a product problem
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this context: [problem]. Identify the core blocker, recommend the next action, and state what I should avoid.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize competing requests
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these requests: [list]. Use our goal, constraints, evidence, and expected impact. Choose one priority and explain the tradeoff.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a metric decline
prompt_templates.prompt: Our [metric] changed from [baseline] to [current] during [period]. Build a diagnosis plan, segment the data, and define decision thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a decision memo
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a decision memo for [decision]. Include facts, assumptions, stakeholders, options, constraints, experiments, metrics, stop conditions, and escalation triggers.

output_examples.input: Our community DAU fell 15 percent for two weeks. Operations wants a campaign.
output_examples.output: 问题判断：先定位下滑来自新老用户、渠道、版本还是供给。行动建议：今天拆分数据，确认主因后再决定活动或回滚。风险提醒：不要用活动掩盖产品或数据问题。

output_examples.input: A leader wants a points mall next week, but the release targets onboarding conversion.
output_examples.output: 问题判断：这是版本目标和临时业务压力的资源冲突。行动建议：提供保持原计划、两天原型验证、替换范围三个选项，并写清指标和延期影响。

output_examples.input: An A/B test raised clicks but did not raise orders.
output_examples.output: 问题判断：点击提升没有传递到购买链路。行动建议：检查流量质量、落地页、下单漏斗和护栏指标，再决定停止、修正或扩大实验。

best_practices: Provide the target outcome, timeframe, affected segment, metrics, constraints, and actions already attempted.
Separate observed facts from interpretations so the skill can calibrate confidence.
Use the recommended metrics and stop conditions to review the decision after execution.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a final decision without sharing the business goal or constraints.
Do not treat isolated feedback as representative evidence without segmentation or validation.
Do not request many equal options when one clear priority and tradeoff are required.

faq.question: What language does this skill use?
faq.answer: It answers in Chinese by default and keeps necessary product abbreviations in English.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the target, symptoms, timeframe, user segment, metrics, constraints, stakeholders, and actions already attempted.

faq.question: Can it help write a PRD?
faq.answer: It can clarify the problem, priority, scope, metrics, and decisions before detailed PRD drafting.

faq.question: Can it read live company data?
faq.answer: No. It only uses information supplied in the conversation or available local context.

faq.question: How does it handle incomplete information?
faq.answer: It gives a conditional judgment, proposes a minimal validation step, and asks up to three decision-changing questions.

faq.question: Is it suitable for high-stakes decisions?
faq.answer: Use it for decision support. Qualified owners must validate legal, financial, security, compliance, and irreversible decisions.
